name: code-block

frames.best_why: The styles tab is selected with CSS shown, proving the tabs work while both panels stay fully visible.

tagline: Two stacked code panels with a file tab row and a copy button.
summary: A dark block that prints source code with numbered lines and colour highlighting, a filename row with a copy icon, and optional file tabs for switching between snippets.
appearance: Two rounded slate-black panels stack with a small gap, each holding numbered lines of code in soft yellow, blue and white monospace. The upper panel shows a filename and a small copy icon; the lower one shows two file tabs.
behaviour: Clicking a file tab swaps the code in the panel, one tab turning white and the other grey. Clicking the copy icon copies the visible snippet and swaps it for a tick for two seconds.
demo_content: A React counter component and a stylesheet with .counter rules, under the filenames counter.tsx and styles.css.
search_phrases: file tabs above a code sample
show an example snippet on a docs page
switch between files in a code viewer
use_when: Docs, changelogs or a portfolio need to show a short snippet with a copy button and file context.
avoid_when: Very long files: the panel has no scroll cap, so tall code stretches the whole page.
customise: Set language, filename, code and line highlights as props, or pass a tabs array for several files; colours and font come from a bundled theme and the source.
weight_why: The snippet is coloured once per tab switch and no animation loop runs.

a11y.note: The icon-only copy button has no label and tabs never announce which one is selected.

issues: The copy control is a tiny, faint icon that is easy to miss.
polish_why: A competent, familiar code panel; copy control and line numbers are small and faint.
